channel.title: Mistral Blog
channel.description: Latest news and updates from Mistral

item.title: Le Chonk brings the brains. Studio puts it to work.
item.description: Build and deploy enterprise agents, workflows and apps faster with Mistral Studio and Le Chonk full control over your models, data and infrastructure.

item.title: Le Chonk: Built for Coders, Trusted by Defenders.
item.description: The weights of Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) are now open. A 1T parameter multimodal model, and best open-weight model for coding, trained in Europe.

item.title: Mistral Advances AI for Engineering with NVIDIA
item.description: Mistral is collaborating with NVIDIA to develop a new generation of AI-native engineering workflows powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing.

item.title: Voxtral 3
item.description: Voxtral 3: Mistral's voice agent SDK for real-time speech in 50+ languages, accurate transcription, emotional TTS, deep tool use.

item.title: Introducing Timestral
item.description: State-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting in four sizes (5M–209M params), CPU-efficient, zero-shot ready.

item.title: Introducing Mistral Large 4
Hallo, Deutschland!
item.description: Mistral opens a Munich hub for Physics AI and Industrial AI research, partnering with German industry.

item.title: Mistral and Mozilla are bringing open, private and multilingual AI to your web browser
item.description: Open, private and multilingual AI is coming to your web browser. Mistral and Mozilla team up to put powerful, trustworthy AI where you already browse.

item.title: Cloudera and Mistral Partner to Bring Specialized, Sovereign Intelligence to Enterprise Data
item.description: Cloudera and Mistral join forces to bring specialized, sovereign AI intelligence to enterprise data, helping regulated industries innovate on their own terms.

item.title: Modernizing complex legacy code with AI agents.
item.description: Mistral helped a European energy operator migrate 40,000 lines of Fortran 77 to C++. Learn how it was done, and the lessons to carry forward.

item.title: Mistral raises €3B to make sovereign, open-weight AI the technology frontier
item.description: Mistral today announced that it has raised €3 billion in a Series D funding round at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion.

item.title: Mistral x HUMAIN
Agentic Search. More accurate and efficient results from your AI systems.
item.description: The retrieval layer that helps AI systems navigate, read, and verify information inside even the most complex documents

item.title: In-region inference, open models, and new European infrastructure for sovereign AI.
item.description: Mistral is bringing together the inference infrastructure, open models, and long-term commitments Europe needs to control its AI future, and setting a roadmap for the world.

item.title: Introducing Shieldstral.
item.description: Shieldstral introduces a 3B open-weights multimodal safety classifier that outperforms models up to 7x its size.

item.title: Your Prompts and Skills need a system of record.
item.description: Studio provides a system of record for AI prompts and skills—versioned, owned, and traceable. Iterate fast, ship with control, and ensure consistent AI behavior.

item.title: Introducing Robostral Navigate
item.description: Introducing Robostral Navigate: 8B model achieving 76.6% on R2R-CE with just a single RGB camera. No depth sensors, LiDAR, or multiple cameras needed.

item.title: Leanstral 1.5: Proof Abundance for All
Bringing more control over your connectors
Introducing Mistral OCR 4
item.description: Mistral OCR 4 delivers enterprise document AI with 170-language support, bounding boxes, and self-hosted deployment.
